text.en:
Today you learn words for people and things you do not know.
Someone is at the door.
Something is burning.

Some: someone, something, somewhere.
Questions: anyone, anything, anywhere.
Is anyone waiting here?
None: nobody, nothing, nowhere.
Nobody answered the phone.
All: everyone, everything.
Everyone has a seat.

You will say no only one time.
I did not see anyone downstairs.
Not two no words in one sentence.
Someone called, but nobody left a message.
Everyone has a seat.
